subject.title: fix(security): add ReDoS guard to exec approval argPattern matching

question: Should persisted exec-approval entries rejected by the new ReDoS guard receive a Doctor-led remediation before this fail-closed runtime behavior lands?
rationale: Arbitrary unsafe regexes cannot be safely rewritten into equivalent patterns automatically; maintainers must choose the operator-visible repair/removal policy while preserving the security boundary.

options.title: Add Doctor remediation
options.body: Recommended: detect unsafe stored `argPattern` entries and provide a deliberate, reported repair or removal flow before enabling the runtime rejection.

options.title: Accept runtime-only rejection
options.body: Land the guard without migration and accept that existing matching entries can stop authorizing commands until operators manually repair them.

options.title: Pause for policy direction
options.body: Hold the PR until the exec-approval owner defines the intended retained-policy and operator-recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Add Doctor remediation
recommendation.body: Recommended: detect unsafe stored `argPattern` entries and provide a deliberate, reported repair or removal flow before enabling the runtime rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only included repository member with recent PR-specific review involvement and can route the security/upgrade decision to the appropriate approval-policy owner.
